title: Sun is 400 times larger and 400 times farther away than the moon
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Sun is 400 times larger and 400 times farther away than the moon, about unspecified at Solar system, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The sun is 400 times larger than the moon and 400 times farther away.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to an odd coincidence: he says the sun is 400 times larger than the moon and also 400 times farther away. He raises it in an episode about the idea that the moon might be something other than natural, since a match that neat could look designed.
